title: Astral Staff
wikitext:
{{Weapon infobox | campaign = [[Eye of the North]] | type = [[Staff]] | attribute = inscribable | damagetype = [[Cold damage|Cold]], [[Earth damage|Earth]], [[Fire damage|Fire]],
[[Chaos damage|Chaos]], [[Dark damage|Dark]] | commonsalvage = [[Pile of Glittering Dust|Piles of Glittering Dust]] | raresalvage = unknown{{research needed|Does it salvage into a rare crafting material?}} | pvpreward = Exotic }} The [[Astral Staff]] is a type of semi-universal staff, requiring the primary attribute of its respective caster profession, except for [[Mesmer]] where it is linked to [[Inspiration Magic]]. It has a straight shaft which tapers to a point, around which is a worm-like wrapping. The staff is animated, the animation being a highlight or glow in the wrapping that travels from the base to the head of the staff. ==Acquisition== '''[[Eye of the North]]''' *[[Dungeon]] **[[Catacombs of Kathandrax]] ***[[Chest of Kathandrax]] ==Dye== Dye affects the whole staff. The shaft dyes very darkly to the color applied but the worm-like wrapping usually dyes to near the opposite color to the one applied. It is dyed yellow by default. {{dye chart}} ==Notes== *You must have your shader quality set to high in your Guild Wars graphics settings to see the animation. *Other items with this appearance: **{{e}} [[Iceblood's Warstaff]] ([[Unique item|unique]]) **{{me}} [[The Rapture]] (unique)
